tdsProducts.potLifeConditions: Master Bond product page states unlimited working life at room temperature for the one-component system.
tdsProducts.tdsDocumentLabel: 3M Scotch-Weld Instant Adhesive CA5 Technical Data Sheet, last revision December 2024, supersedes June 2024; PDF creation date December 11, 2024
tdsProducts.cureDetail: One-part ethyl cyanoacrylate; moisture-triggered room-temperature cure
tdsProducts.fixtureTimeNote: Published as Time to Handling Strength 12-60 s.
tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: 3M Scotch-Weld Instant Adhesive CA5 Technical Data Sheet, last revision December 2024, supersedes June 2024; PDF creation date December 11, 2024
tdsProducts.summary: Slow-setting higher-viscosity instant adhesive for rough or uneven parts where you want a little alignment time before lockup.
cautions: Pot life is not applicable/not published for this one-component instant adhesive.
Thermal conductivity and lap-shear strength are not published in the cached official 3M TDS.
For optimum strength structural bonds, remove paint, oxide films, oils, dust, mold release agents and other contaminants.
When using solvents, extinguish ignition sources and follow solvent manufacturer precautions.
Store refrigerated at 0-4 C / 32-40 F; do not freeze; keep containers tightly covered and free of moisture; avoid direct sun.
Industrial/occupational product; not designed or tested for certain automotive applications including electric powertrain battery or high-voltage applications.
tdsProducts.serviceTemperatureNote: TDS prints Long Term Temperature Resistance -82 C (180 F) and Minimum Long Term Temperature Resistance -54 C (-65 F); 180 F corresponds to +82 C, so the printed -82 C appears to be a sign error.
tdsProducts.lapShearSubstrate: Not published in cached official 3M CA5 TDS; previous 17.2 MPa value is intentionally removed as unsupported by this source.

tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: LePage Super Glue Liquid Pro Technical Data Sheet, 2015
tdsProducts.summary: Liquid CA for close-fitting household repairs, with fixture and lap-shear tables for multiple substrates.
cautions: Not for polystyrene foam, foam rubber, bone china, glass, silicone rubber, PE, PP, PTFE, glazed surfaces, hot-liquid assemblies, high-flex joints or gap filling. Do not place bonded items in oven or microwave.
tdsProducts.tdsLapShearTestMethod: ISO 4587; substrate-specific shear values after 72 h at 22°C. Examples: steel grit-blasted 17–24 MPa; aluminum etched 2–11 MPa.
tdsProducts.lapShearSubstrate: The linked TDS reports substrate-specific results/ranges; see its exact test conditions below.
tdsProducts.storageCondition: Unopened shelf life is 21 months at 2–8°C and also 21 months at 20°C; keep sealed and dry after opening.

tdsProducts.name: LePage Super Glue Longneck Bottle
tdsProducts.tdsDocumentLabel: LePage Super Glue Longneck Bottle Technical Data Sheet, revision May 1, 2024
tdsProducts.cureDetail: Fixture time 15–30 seconds; leave undisturbed for at least 10 minutes. Full cure strength is reached in 24 hours.
tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: LePage Super Glue Longneck Bottle Technical Data Sheet, revision May 1, 2024
tdsProducts.summary: Ethyl cyanoacrylate with an extended precision nozzle for controlled drops and hard-to-reach repairs.
cautions: Not for PE, PP, PTFE, silicone, foam rubber, polystyrene foams, glass, very soft leather or bone china. Not for oven/microwave/dishwasher, hot-liquid assemblies, exterior exposure, high-flex joints or gap filling.
tdsProducts.tdsLapShearTestMethod: ISO 4587; TDS tensile-shear strength varies by substrate from 10–20 MPa after 12–24 h cure.
tdsProducts.lapShearSubstrate: The linked TDS reports substrate-specific results/ranges; see its exact test conditions below.

tdsProducts.name: LePage Super Glue Ultra Gel Control
tdsProducts.tdsDocumentLabel: LePage Super Glue Ultra Gel Control Technical Data Sheet, revision April 30, 2015
tdsProducts.cureDetail: Fixture time 15–30 seconds by TDS typical property; hold the parts for 60 seconds in the application instructions. Leave at least 10 minutes before handling; full cure in 24 hours.
tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: LePage Super Glue Ultra Gel Control Technical Data Sheet, revision April 30, 2015
tdsProducts.tdsImpactStrength: More than 60 drops to break the bonded item (TDS drop test).
tdsProducts.summary: Rubber-toughened CA gel for shock, vibration and higher-flexibility repairs; TDS reports peel, tensile-shear and drop-test results.
cautions: Not for PE, PP, PTFE, silicone rubber, polystyrene foams or glass. TDS says moisture resistant but not suitable for continuous water exposure. Avoid dishwasher, oven and microwave; not for hot-liquid assemblies.
tdsProducts.tdsLapShearTestMethod: ISO 4587; TDS reports 15–25 MPa by substrate and 21.12 MPa on aluminum after 12–24 h cure.
tdsProducts.lapShearSubstrate: The linked TDS reports substrate-specific results/ranges; see its exact test conditions below.
tdsProducts.waterResistanceNote: Moisture resistant but not intended for continuous water exposure; TDS reports EN 204 D3.
tdsProducts.storageCondition: Unopened shelf life: 24 months at 2–8°C or 18 months at 20°C; store dry and sealed after opening.

tdsProducts.name: LePage Super Glue Ultra Liquid Control
tdsProducts.tdsDocumentLabel: LePage Super Glue Ultra Liquid Control Technical Data Sheet, revision July 3, 2014
tdsProducts.cureDetail: Fixture time 10–30 seconds; leave undisturbed at least 10 minutes. Full cure is 24 hours.
tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: LePage Super Glue Ultra Liquid Control Technical Data Sheet, revision July 3, 2014
tdsProducts.summary: Moisture-resistant liquid CA in a side-squeeze precision bottle; manufacturer TDS describes a dishwasher-safe formula for indoor repairs.
cautions: Not for PE, PP, PTFE, foam or silicone rubber, polystyrene foam, glass, bone china or very soft leather. Not for oven/microwave, hot-liquid assemblies, glazed surfaces, exterior exposure, high-flex joints or gap filling.
tdsProducts.tdsLapShearTestMethod: ISO 4587; TDS strength varies 10–20 MPa by substrate, with aluminum at 15.5 MPa after 12–24 h cure.
tdsProducts.lapShearSubstrate: The linked TDS reports substrate-specific results/ranges; see its exact test conditions below.
tdsProducts.storageCondition: Unopened shelf life: 30 months refrigerated at 2–8°C or 18 months at 20°C; after opening, store tightly sealed in a dry place.
